defs.def: not unusual or different in any way 普通的；平常的；一般的；平凡的

ex.s: These ordinary moments speak to a philosophical puzzle: Are moral people happier? ____35____ Others might reason that moral behavior often requires self-sacrifice.
ex.t: 这些平凡的时刻指向一个哲学谜题：有道德的人更快乐吗？____35____ 也有人会认为道德行为常常需要自我牺牲。

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 的确，在环境变化方面，我们会产生一种集体的"健忘"，每一代新人都可能认为他们所遇到的事态再正常不过。

ex.s: Their lifestyles were typical of ordinary people.
ex.t: 他们的生活方式是普通人的典型。

ex.s: “Painters, sculptors—they've all tried to make the best of this ordinary face, but I'm afraid there's not much hope.
ex.t: “画家、雕塑家——他们都试图把这张普通的脸塑造到最好，但我怕希望不大。”

ex.s: Ordinary soap, _________ correctly, can deal with bacteria effectively.
ex.t: 在今天的信息时代，数据丢失可能会给公司造成严重问题。

ex.s: More ordinary forms of adaptation are happening everywhere.
ex.t: 更为普通的适应形式正在各地发生。

ex.s: Human beings will continue to adapt to the changing climate in both ordinary and astonishing ways.
ex.t: 人类将继续以普通和惊人的方式适应不断变化的气候。

ex.s: Unfortunately, that plan seems unlikely to work: we have yet to invent a firewall that is secure against ordinary humans, let alone super intelligent machines.
ex.t: 可惜，那个计划似乎不太可能奏效：我们至今还没发明出一种能挡住普通人的防火墙，更别说超级智能机器了。

ex.s: He co-founded the Frank Lloyd Wright Building Conservancy, an organization engaged in the preservation of all of Wright’s remaining buildings.
ex.t: 他共同创立了Frank Lloyd Wright建筑保护协会，该组织致力于保护Wright现存的所有建筑。

ex.s: Conservation organizations put out pollinator-friendliness guidelines for home gardens, businesses, schools, cities—and now there are guidelines for solar farms.
ex.t: 保护组织发布了针对家庭花园、企业、学校和城市的传粉昆虫友好指南——现在也有了针对太阳能农场的指南。

ex.s: We offer scholarships to low-income schools and youth organizations, subject to availability.
ex.t: 我们为低收入学校和青年组织提供奖学金，视名额而定。

ex.s: A successful swap depends on the selection of clothes, the organization of the event, and, obviously, how much fun is had.
ex.t: 一次成功的交换取决于衣服的选择、活动的组织，当然还有玩得有多开心。

ex.s: In the past few years, an increasing number of people and organisations have begun coming up with plans to counter this trend.
ex.t: 过去几年里，越来越多的人和组织开始提出计划来遏制这一趋势。

ex.s: The result was Project Wild Thing, a film which charts the birth of the Wild Network a group of organisations with the common goal of getting children out into nature.
ex.t: 成果是《野生动物计划》这部影片，它记录了“野生网络”的诞生——一个由多个组织组成的、以让孩子走进自然为共同目标的团体。

ex.s: One nonprofit organization, which monitors the treatment or animals in filmed entertainment, is keeping tabs on more than 2,000 productions this year.
ex.t: 一个监控影视娱乐中动物待遇的非营利组织今年正在跟踪2000多部制作。

ex.s: Local organizations can adopt them for l pound, and install defibrillators to help in emergencies.
ex.t: 在农村地区，救护车可能需要较长时间才能到达，电话亭承担了救生的角色。

ex.s: their new appearance and lower pricesB. the push of the local organizations
ex.t: 它们焕然一新的外观和更低的价格 B. 地方组织的推动

ex.s: Wilson first worked as a driver through a student-support programme of the non-profit organisation.
ex.t: 威尔逊最初是通过一家非营利组织的学生支持项目当司机的。

ex.s: More than 23 percent of adults and 80 percent of adolescents don't get enough physical activity, and according to a 2019 report from the World Health Organization.
ex.t: 超过23%的成年人和80%的青少年缺乏足够的身体活动，根据世界卫生组织2019年的一份报告。

ex.s: The organizations were established in the 1930s by Westerners in China to promote industrial and economic development.
ex.t: 这些组织是20世纪30年代由在华西方人建立的，旨在促进工业和经济发展。

ex.s: It’s an amazing accomplishment and one we connot achive without generous support from individuals, corporations, and other social organizations.
ex.t: 这是一项了不起的成就，如果没有个人、企业和其他社会组织的慷慨支持，我们不可能取得这样的成就。

ex.s: I work with Volunteers for Wildlife, a rescue and education organization at Bailey Arboretum in Locust Valley.
ex.t: 我在“野生动物志愿者”——一家位于洛克斯特谷贝利植物园的救援与教育组织——工作。

ex.s: His not-for-profit organization runs 100 river boats that serve as floating libraries, schools, and health clinics, and are equipped with solar panels and other communicating facilities.
ex.t: 他的非营利组织运营着100艘河船，这些船作为流动图书馆、学校和诊所运营，并配备太阳能板和其他通讯设施。

ex.s: Different organizations work with each other.
ex.t: 不同的组织相互合作。

ex.s: His organization makes the best of a bad situation.
ex.t: 他的组织在糟糕的处境中做到最好。

ex.s: She started the Ladybug Foundation, an organization aiming at getting rid of homelessness.
ex.t: 她创办了Ladybug基金会,这是一个旨在摆脱无家可归状况的组织.

ex.s: In his stories, he often focused on the everyday life of ordinary people in New York City at that time.
ex.t: 在他的故事中，他经常关注当时纽约市普通人的日常生活。

ex.s: Last week, I went to the butcher's and asked "Do you have pigs'ears?""No,"the butcher said, pulling at his own ears,"just these ordinary ones."He must have thought I was joking.
ex.t: 上周，我去肉铺问：“你们有猪耳朵吗？”“没有，”肉贩拉着自己的耳朵说，“只有这些普通的。”他一定以为我在开玩笑。

ex.s: After all, the most extraordinary stories often happen in the most ordinary places.
ex.t: 毕竟最非凡的故事经常发生在最普通的地方.

ex.s: You see, this was no ordinary criminal: it was a chacma baboon.
ex.t: 你看，这不是一个普通的罪犯：这是一只豚尾狒狒。

ex.s: Life Behind the Lens A white-haired old man riding an ordinary bicycle around the streets of New York, always wearing the same blue worker’s jacket and simple black running shoes.
ex.t: 镜头背后的人生：一位白发老人骑着普通自行车穿行在纽约的街道上，总是穿着那件同样的蓝色工装夹克和简单的黑色跑鞋。

defs.def: having no unusual or interesting features 平庸的；平淡无奇的

ex.s: It helps to provide healthy alternatives to sugary drinks; and also Tom donates part of the profits to the Organisation for a Healthier Generation (OHG).
ex.t: 它有助于提供替代含糖饮料的健康选择；而且汤姆把部分利润捐给更健康一代组织（OHG）。
